column4: The round light pattern that an old cheap 1990s incandescent hand torch with a scratched chrome reflector throws straight onto a flat white wall in a completely dark room, seen straight on, centred, filling the middle of the picture: a bright warm yellow hot spot with a small darker ring hole in its middle from the bulb's filament, two or three faint concentric rings from the reflector around it, then a much dimmer wide soft halo, all fading to pure black well before the edges of the picture. A few faint smudges from a dirty lens. Pure black around it, no wall texture, no torch, no hand, no text, no border.

Straight-on view of the beam of a worn 1990s two-battery metal hand torch with a yellowish incandescent bulb shone at a white wall in the dark from two metres: a round pool of warm light in the centre of the picture with a sharp bright rim around the hot centre, the centre itself slightly uneven with the filament's faint shadow, a ring of darker gap, then a dim uneven outer spill with soft streaks from the dented reflector, fading to pure black long before the edges. Pure black everywhere else, no wall detail, no torch, no hand, no text, no border.
